name: Zabbix Problem Triage
description: NOC triage of Zabbix problems for MSPs: pulling open problems by severity and customer host group, resolving each problem to its host through the trigger or event, separating cause from symptom and suppressed problems, checking maintenance and acknowledgement state, confirming whether an alert was actually sent, and reading recent event history for flapping. Read-only: the plugin cannot acknowledge or close problems.
